target.title: fix(agents): keep missing error details out of auth health
target.body:
Related: #100600

AI-assisted: yes. Maintainer rewrite reviewed the full auth-profile failure owner, embedded runner callers, fallback siblings, tests, and provider normalization contract.

## What Problem This Solves

An OpenAI-compatible provider can emit `response.failed` without useful error fields. OpenClaw classified that as `no_error_details`, persisted it as auth-profile health, and cooled a valid API key. Later models on the same provider then appeared to have no usable login even though the credential was healthy.

## Why This Change Was Made

An opaque provider failure is useful for retry and model-fallback decisions, but it is not credential-health evidence. The final implementation keeps that runtime classification and moves the persistence gate into the canonical auth-profile state owner:

- API-key profiles never persist `no_error_details` as cooldown state.
- OpenAI OAuth profiles retain the existing WHAM probe, which can provide independent subscription/auth evidence.
- Classified auth, billing, quota, timeout, and other failure behavior remains unchanged.

This replaces the earlier provider-name special case in the embedded runner. Checking the credential type at the auth-state boundary also handles OpenAI API keys correctly; they cannot use the OAuth-only WHAM contract.

## User Impact

Valid API-key profiles remain immediately reusable after an upstream detail-less failure. The existing replay-safe retry and configured model fallback still run, while OpenAI OAuth health keeps its evidence-backed WHAM handling.

## Evidence

Final reviewed head: `4e5c93a9455bc18181efb1f1aedcb9dba2f16b73`.

- Sanitized public-network AWS Crabbox, no IAM role, no Tailscale, no hydrated credentials: [focused run](https://crabbox.openclaw.ai/portal/runs/run_cf53a0be5e58) passed 404 tests across the OpenAI transport, auth failure policy, auth usage/state, and embedded fallback suites.
- Real Gateway + CLI agent proof: [live scenario run](https://crabbox.openclaw.ai/portal/runs/run_f8bd62367bf5) connected Gateway RPC, sent a real Responses SSE `response.failed` with empty details to the configured primary, retried through the production path, returned `LIVE_FALLBACK_OK` from the configured fallback, and then inspected the persisted auth store.
- Live result: 4 primary requests, 1 fallback request, primary `cooldownUntil = null`, and `failureCounts.no_error_details = 0`.
- The focused and live runs used predecessor head `15081b7c83242a91b6e6f8798ead90f5c3668533`; stable patch-id comparison confirms the four runtime/test files are byte-equivalent after the final main rebase. Final-head hosted gates provide exact-head integration proof.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- `git diff --check` and targeted `oxfmt` passed.

No screenshot is included because this is a non-UI persisted-state bug; the structured Gateway run and auth-store result are the direct before/after proof.
